title: Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop: Hybrid Projection and Automated Tuning for Distributed Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.19423v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Configuring distributed LLM training across hundreds of GPUs requires jointly optimizing tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism alongside micro-batch size, recomputation, sharding, and overlap, a combinatorial space where memory legality can hinge on a single byte of activation accounting. Today, teams navigate it through expensive multi-node trial and error, burning GPU-hours on crashes and suboptimal recipes. We present Primus Projection, which closes this loop with two coupled components. First, a hybrid projection engine that measures what it can and simulates what it cannot: GPU microbenchmarks on as few as a single device capture compute kernels and any in-scope communication; a sub-node downscale-measure-upscale workflow analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and the full pipeline schedule at the multi-node target. A pure simulation mode runs entirely on CPU, enabling pre-silicon plannin

translated_title: 超越试错循环：面向分布式训练的混合投影与自动调优
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19423v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：在数百个GPU上配置分布式大语言模型训练，需要联合优化张量、流水线、专家、上下文和数据并行，以及微批大小、重计算、分片和重叠等选项，这是一个组合爆炸的空间，其中内存是否合法可能仅取决于单个字节的激活内存核算。如今，团队只能通过昂贵的多节点试错来摸索，在崩溃和次优配置上浪费大量GPU时。我们提出Primus Projection，通过两个相互耦合的组件来闭环这一过程。首先，是一个“能测则测、不能测则模拟”的混合投影引擎：仅在单台设备上运行的GPU微基准测试即可捕获计算内核以及所有可观测范围内的通信行为；随后通过节点内缩小-测量-放大的工作流程，以解析方式还原目标多节点环境下的不可观测集合通信、FSDP重叠以及完整的流水线调度。此外，纯模拟模式可完全在CPU上运行，从而支持芯片交付前的规划预演。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Primus Projection框架，通过“单设备微基准测量+解析式缩放还原”的混合投影引擎与可在CPU上运行的纯模拟模式，精确预测多节点分布式LLM训练的性能与内存行为，从而取代代价高昂且极易崩溃的多节点试错调优过程。
en_tdlr: Primus Projection replaces costly multi-node trial-and-error in distributed LLM training with a hybrid projection engine that measures compute kernels via single-device microbenchmarks, analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and pipeline schedules, and offers a CPU-only pure simulation mode for pre-silicon planning.
